title: Three separate routes to open Coldpass (3 hollows rested, Regent's Writ via 2 Watch services, Free Companies' word/smugglers' road for 15 gold) all stayed open at once; once I qualified for the free pilgrim-stair route, Captain Vane's 15-gold smugglers'-road offer became permanently moot with no in-fiction acknowledgement that I'd found a better deal.
